content.title: Proposed Staffing Model
content.content:
- **Project Manager** — SnapLogic PS (part-time, coordination and reporting)

- **Lead Solutions Engineer** — SnapLogic PS (full-time during Phases 0–2)

- **Integration Developer x2** — SnapLogic PS (full-time Phases 1–2)

- **SnapLogic Support** — dedicated named CSM throughout engagement

- **AH Integration Team** — shadow developers from Phase 1 for knowledge transfer
